description: Where one Predict.fun wallet's money came from and went: its USDT deposits (`in`) and withdrawals (`out`) on BNB Chain, newest first, each with the counterparty address and our label for it, such as cex/binance; transfers with Predict.fun's own contracts (trading, splits, merges, redemptions) are left out. Returns {flows, totals, next_cursor, as_of_ts}; totals cover the whole history since 2025-11-21: deposited, withdrawn, net, and the first deposit with its sender (`first_funder`). It is the wallet's whole USDT traffic outside Predict.fun (a wallet also used elsewhere carries that activity too); dust under one cent and per-transaction fees are left out.

address.description: The wallet, 0x and 40 hex digits. Required.

cursor.description: A previous page's `next_cursor`, unchanged, to read the next page.
